instruction: Using these images as the exact style and design reference (same chibi knight, same thick dark outlines, same flat two-tone cel shading, same blue-and-silver plate armour, same colours), draw ONLY ONE game-art part for 2D cutout animation, alone, centred, whole and complete with a closed outline all round, large and filling most of the image height. Transparent background, nothing else in the image, no shadow, no text. The part: one armoured shin: the silver-blue knee guard at the top and the greave down to the ankle, straight, pointing down, with a black fabric knee end showing above the knee guard, no boot
